chunks.core: landfinder.py from `def log` to `class Store`: number/area parsing, FX, flags, fix_down_payment, property_type, finalize
chunks.store: landfinder.py from `class Store` to `def parse_properstar`: Store (save/resume/dedupe), Metrics, Browser, Plain, search_pages
chunks.parsers_a: landfinder.py from `def parse_properstar` to `def strip_tags`: Properstar, LandWatch, Kijiji, OLX, Mercado Libre, Ieichiba parsers and crawlers, crawl_search
chunks.parsers_b: landfinder.py from `def strip_tags` to `def same_title`: Zillow, Immobiliare, HOME'S, Encuentra24 parsers, verify_cheapest, translate, add_english
chunks.outputs: landfinder.py from `def same_title` to the end (build_outputs, site_codes, towns, build_site, write_coverage, main), plus site_template.html, report_template.html and functions/api/visitors.js

categories.parsing: number, currency, area and unit parsing; locale separators; ranges and per-unit prices
categories.logic: off-by-one, wrong comparisons, wrong branch order, None/empty/zero inputs, early returns that skip work
categories.data: records lost, duplicated, overwritten or mis-merged; resume and de-duplication; sorting with missing values
categories.errors: swallowed exceptions, crashes on unexpected HTML/JSON, partial writes, resources not cleaned up
categories.security: XSS or HTML injection from scraped titles into the site/report, unsafe file paths, injection into subprocess calls, the visitors.js endpoint
